hero.title: Copy once.
hero.description: UniClipboard syncs your clipboard across macOS, Windows, and Linux — encrypted end-to-end, local-first, no account required.

features.title: It does not move your clipboard into the cloud. It keeps it between your devices.
features.subtitle: Three things that matter: why it feels better, why it is easier to trust, and why it holds up long term.

local.title: Local-first, not cloud-first
local.description: When devices are on the same network, they talk directly. Your clipboard does not need to detour through a central server just to come back.

frictionless.title: Less confirmation, less interruption
frictionless.description: After one pairing step, UniClipboard reconnects in the background. You do not repeat a sharing flow every time you copy across devices.

private.title: Encrypted by default, explainable by design
private.description: Content is encrypted before it leaves your device. The point is not to ask for blind trust, but to make the sync model understandable.

howItWorks.title: Three steps are enough.

step1.title: Pair once
step1.description: Approve the first connection and create a trusted relationship between devices. You should not need to repeat that every time you copy.

step2.title: Reconnect automatically

step3.title: Sync directly and securely
step3.description: Clipboard data is encrypted before it leaves your device, then transferred directly over your network instead of through an opaque middle layer.

faq.title: Before you decide.
faq.subtitle: The questions that actually move the decision.

item1.a:
UniClipboard is a cross-device clipboard sync tool that lets you seamlessly copy and paste text and files between Mac, Windows, and Linux.
Its core goal is simple: make multi-device work feel natural without sacrificing privacy.

item2.q: How is it different from iCloud / Windows Clipboard / other tools?
item2.a:
The biggest differences are three things:
- Privacy-first: end-to-end encryption, no plaintext cloud storage
- Decentralized design: devices communicate directly, no central server
- Open-source & auditable: you can see where data goes and how it is handled
If you care about what your clipboard contains, that's exactly the problem UniClipboard aims to solve.

item3.q: Will my clipboard data be uploaded to the cloud?
item3.a:
No.
UniClipboard does not store your clipboard content in the cloud.
All data is encrypted and transferred only between devices you trust, and we cannot read your content.

item4.q: Can you see my clipboard content?
item4.a:
No - and you don't have to take our word for it.
- Clipboard data is encrypted locally
- Transit is end-to-end encrypted
- There is no central server that can peek
Even the developers cannot decrypt your clipboard contents.

item5.a:
Because most existing solutions either:
- Lock you into an ecosystem
- Rely too heavily on the cloud
- Are opaque about privacy
UniClipboard is a long-term answer, not a pile of features.

item6.q: Can I use it right now?
item6.a:
It's currently in Private Alpha.
That means:
- Features are evolving quickly
- Bugs are possible
- It's best for early users who want to help refine the product
If you're willing to test and share real feedback, you're welcome to join.
